name: Politecnico di Milano
summary: Milan's technical university for engineering, architecture and design; six English bachelor's across Milan, Lecco, Piacenza and Cremona.

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts if you entered the IB after promotion to your penultimate school year. A diploma taught in English meets the English rule; every degree ranks you on an entrance test.

programmes.name: Architectural Design (English track)
programmes.about: Designing architecture at every scale, from history, representation and maths to building technology and conservation, in design studios; English tracks in Milan and Piacenza.
programmes.overview: You study design and architectural composition alongside history and theory, conservation of historic buildings, building physics, structural mechanics, materials and construction technology, with mathematics for representation, urban design, sociology and project evaluation. Design training is central: multidisciplinary studios work hand in hand with theory courses, supported by seminars, workshops and study trips, and a mandatory internship links you to professional practice. Graduates work in design firms, public institutions and construction management, and can register as junior architects after the state exam or continue to a master's in architecture, landscape or urban planning.
programmes.ib: National ARCHED test in English; 2026: register 17 June–16 July, test 23 July. English tracks: Milano Leonardo (50 EU places) and Piacenza (10).
programmes.selectionNote: Places go by ARCHED test score and your stated preferences. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: register 17 June–16 July; ARCHED test 23 July

programmes.name: Civil Engineering (English track)
programmes.about: Planning, design, construction and upkeep of structures and infrastructure such as bridges, tunnels, dams, water systems and transport networks, on a base of maths and physics.
programmes.overview: The first year is mathematics, physics, chemistry and computer science. The second brings the core civil subjects: structural mechanics and design, geotechnics, fluid mechanics, hydraulic engineering, infrastructure and transport design, and surveying and monitoring. In the third year you apply them to steel and reinforced concrete design, earthworks, hydraulic projects and transport infrastructure, with material technology and construction management alongside. Graduates work in the public or private sector on soils, structures, transport, hydraulics, civil protection and surveying, and can sit the professional exam as junior engineers or continue to a master's in Civil Engineering, Risk Mitigation or Built Environment Management.
programmes.ib: Ranked on an entrance test: the TOL (in Italian), or CEnT-S (in English) or the SAT instead.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score, with a separate ranking for the English-taught programmes. 2026 criteria; 2027 details due around January 2027.

programmes.name: Engineering Science
programmes.about: A broad engineering degree: a common core of maths, physics, chemistry, materials and computing, then you gradually choose a field instead of committing on day one.
programmes.overview: The degree has four parts. A core area in the first two years blends mathematics, physics, chemistry, materials and computer science, with Engineering Corners that introduce methods from across engineering. In years two and three, a direction area of electives points you toward fields such as mechanics, fluids, automation or electronics, and a third-year focus area goes deeper into one. It ends with a hands-on interdisciplinary capstone project, often with industry or research labs. Teaching mixes lectures, hands-on and virtual labs, group projects and presentations. Graduates work where engineering fields meet, or continue to specialised master's degrees.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: Manufacturing, automation, logistics and digital innovation, taught in three terms a year with labs, projects and industrial partners on the Piacenza campus.
programmes.overview: You study mechanical systems and manufacturing technologies, industrial automation, operations and logistics, data analysis and decision-making, and sustainability and energy management, across three terms each year. Lectures are matched with integrated lab sessions, team projects, case studies from partner companies and simulation software, with daily class time kept to four or five hours to leave room for independent work. In the last term of year three you choose between a company internship tied to your thesis or a project with industry or research teams. Graduates work in manufacturing, automation, logistics, operations and quality, or continue to master's degrees in Mechanical, Energy, Management or Automation and Control Engineering.

programmes.name: Process Engineering
programmes.about: Designing and optimising industrial processes that turn raw materials into chemicals, energy, food and medicines, with automation, data analytics, AI and digital twins.
programmes.overview: After a first stage in mathematics, physics, chemistry and computer science, you move into automation and control, materials, production systems management and information engineering, then model identification, data analysis, digital twins and process simulation, with sustainable and circular engineering throughout. Teaching mixes lectures, labs, group projects and work with industrial partners, and electives tailor the final year. A capstone project, which can be an internship, project work or a collaboration with industry or research, completes the degree. Graduates work in production, process design, automation and quality in chemical, pharmaceutical, energy and food firms, or go on to a master's.

programmes.name: Interaction Design
programmes.about: Designing apps, websites, smart devices and IoT systems that mix digital and physical parts, with user research, prototyping and programming, in Lecco.
programmes.overview: You learn the full design process for products, services and interactive systems that mix digital and physical parts, starting from user needs, how people interact, usability and accessibility. The curriculum draws on design, humanities, technology and representation, with a focus on interactive artefacts, digital interfaces and IoT systems. Lectures are combined with design studios and workshops, where you practise programming, prototyping and representation by doing. The degree is taught in English on the Lecco campus. Graduates work as interaction designers, UX and UI designers or information architects in design studios, technology companies and agencies, or continue to Politecnico's master's in Digital and Interaction Design.
programmes.ib: Design entrance test (TOLD) sat in English, in person in Italy, once only; 2026 window 14 March–14 May.
